name: Torrent Pharmaceuticals Ltd.
business_summary: Ahmedabad-based branded-generics company strong in chronic cardiac, CNS, gastro and diabetes in India, with Brazil, Germany, the US and RoW. After acquiring/merging JB Chemicals (consolidated from the Mar-2026 quarter) quarterly sales stepped up from Rs 3.3k cr to Rs 4.9-5.0k cr. Q2 FY27: sales Rs 4,979 cr (+51%), operating profit Rs 1,666 cr (33.5%), net profit Rs 534 cr (-10% YoY) because interest (Rs 300 cr) and depreciation/amortisation (Rs 609 cr) jumped. Borrowings Rs 14,107 cr.

exposures.mechanism: Borrowings Rs 14,107 cr (Sep-26) after the JB Chemicals acquisition; interest Rs 300 cr/qtr. Assume 50% floating: +25bp x Rs 7,050 cr = Rs 18 cr/yr vs PBT ~Rs 2,900 cr annualised = -0.6%; plus P/E-82 discount-rate effect; persistence 0.5, EV/MCap 1.08 -> -1.0.

evidence.note: RBI MPC hiked repo 25bp to 5.50%, stance calibrated tightening (Reuters/The Hindu headlines)

exposures.mechanism: P/E 82 (distorted by amortisation), market cap Rs 1.79 lakh cr, long-duration defensive growth: +25bp -> cost of equity +25bp -> -2.5% x beta to rates 0.7 -> -1.8.

evidence.note: screener.in financials retrieved 2026-11-05; weight is model-derived (see mechanism)

exposures.mechanism: International business ~40% of sales (Brazil, Germany, US, RoW; model knowledge) but Brazil/Germany earn in BRL/EUR; US ~8-10% of sales; imported APIs ~20% of costs. +3% USD/INR: foreign revenue +1.1% of sales, import cost -0.5% => +0.6% of sales / OPM 33% = +1.8% EBITDA x persistence 0.4 -> +0.8. Empirical +0.92 (t=0.8) agrees.
